[engine] Do not trust a variable name for its semantics: check what the caller actually passes, especially when the same name exists at two layers of the stack.

**class**: `source-reading`

## 為什麼（because）

build_moe_ffn's n_tokens is NOT ubatch.n_tokens - the hook observed t->ne[1] == 2 while the ubatch was 1 (all 80 hook lines reported n_tok=2). Writing n_tokens == 1 as the decode condition meant the decode step never built the table at all; only the dummy reserve build did.
